devon: CI alert on PR #10987 — microbench threshold diffs triggered on CI. Batch kernel selector seems to flip choice for seq_len<=64, median +12% and p95 +25%. https://ci.redwood/7221

devon: Failing test: `microbench/batcher_selector_test` output:
```
FAIL: median 1.12s -> 1.26s (+12.5%)
Regression window: 2026-03-15..2026-03-17
Stack: runtime/kernel_selector.py:118
```

sanjay: looking... I see a change in commit `abc1234` (PR 10950) that adjusted affinity score math. can bisect.

maria: that was my PR — I tweaked prefer_small_seq=true for quantized kernels to reduce cost. didn't expect perf cliff.

tyler: @devon can you tag this as rollout-blocker? we hit customer SLA risk on Dedicated tests.

devon: yes rolling back if bisect confirms. marking P0 / rollout-blocker :exclamation:

perf-bot: Regression summary for PR 10987:
- benchmark: `microbench_small_seq`
- delta(median): +12.3%
- delta(p95): +24.7%
- likely cause: kernel-selector heuristics

sanjay: running local microbench...
```
$ ./scripts/run_microbench --bench small_seq --runs 50
median: 110ms -> 123ms
p95: 210ms -> 262ms
```

maria: noticed KV-cache hitrate dropped ~8% in the same run, maybe selector chooses kernel path that disables prefix caching for small batches.

devon: can you dump a profile? `perf record` + `pprof` would help.

maria: attached flame (pasted):
```
kv_cache_lookup 45%
kernel_dispatch 30%
other 25%
```

tyler: if kv_cache_lookup goes up and hitrate drops that explains tail, selector change might alter batching path (prefers fused kernel that bypasses cached KVs).

sanjay: bisect plan:
1) checkout `main`@pre-10950
2) run microbench harness
3) reapply 10950 change
4) compare
I'll run now.

sanjay: bisect quick results: pre-10950 median 109ms, post-10950 123ms -> confirmed cause.

devon: thanks. @maria can you open a revert for your 10950 change? or should we implement a small safeguard in selector to prefer KV-safe kernels when cache hitrate > 5%?

maria: opening revert PR now: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/11002

ci-bot: PR 11002 created by maria. CI started.

ci-bot: PR 11002 CI ✅ all microbench golden guards passed (median diff within threshold)

devon: merging revert and kicking off canary.

ci-bot: Canary deploy started to dedicated pool zone-us-west-2-canary.

tyler: keep an eye on cost telemetry but SLA stability > correctness here.

maria: follow-up: I'll add a unit-test that ensures selector doesn't pick non-kv-friendly kernels when kv cache enabled. Also add telemetry to flag future flips.

devon: great. closing rollout blocker once canary stable. TY all :thumbsup:
